research_mode: official UK government and ONS primary statistical publications and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: Reporting period
verified_claims: The second-edition statistics cover 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.
limitations: The period is a national annual window and not a current parcel-level measure.

sources.name: Second-edition force coverage
verified_claims: Data were collected from 43 Home Office funded forces and British Transport Police.
limitations: Coverage does not imply uniform recording systems across forces.

sources.name: Official-statistics classification
verified_claims: The year ending March 2025 release is classified as official statistics.
limitations: The classification does not remove known administrative-data limitations.

sources.name: Publication series start
verified_claims: The police use-of-force series has been published since the year ending March 2018.
limitations: Earlier Taser-only collections are not fully comparable with the wider use-of-force series.

sources.name: Second-edition status
verified_claims: The publication was updated to a second edition on 4 June 2026.
limitations: The first edition should not be treated as the latest version.

sources.name: Derbyshire revision trigger
verified_claims: The second edition followed revised Derbyshire Police data after a system change.
limitations: The revision shows that system migrations can alter published records.

sources.name: Report-count revision
verified_claims: The Derbyshire revision reduced the national report total by two.
limitations: A small national count change does not show where or why local incidents occurred.

sources.name: Tactic-field revision
verified_claims: The Derbyshire resubmission changed some recorded tactic content.
limitations: Tactic comparisons must use the latest version of the data.

sources.name: Officer-injury revision
verified_claims: The Derbyshire resubmission changed some officer-injury content.
limitations: Officer-injury fields are administrative records rather than clinical findings.

sources.name: Report and tactic units
verified_claims: The release provides both report counts and tactic counts.
limitations: Tactic totals can exceed report totals and must not be interpreted as unique incidents.

sources.name: Person-detail scope
verified_claims: The release includes person details such as age and gender.
limitations: These fields are not suitable for identifying an individual.

sources.name: Reason scope
verified_claims: The release includes officers' recorded reasons for using force.
limitations: Reasons recorded in a multi-value report are not necessarily linked to a specific tactic.

sources.name: Outcome scope
verified_claims: The release includes recorded outcomes associated with use-of-force reports.
limitations: An outcome recorded on a report is not proof that force caused that outcome.

sources.name: Injury scope
verified_claims: The release includes reported injuries to officers and people involved.
limitations: Reported injuries can be incomplete, duplicated across officers or unrelated to a tactic.

sources.name: Open-data availability
verified_claims: The second edition includes an open-data table alongside aggregate tables.
limitations: Open-data availability does not remove disclosure, interpretation or quality constraints.

sources.name: Latest-version requirement
verified_claims: The 4 June 2026 second edition is the current published version for the period.
limitations: Cached or earlier copies should not be mixed with revised records.

sources.name: National analytical scope
verified_claims: The publication is designed to describe police use of force across England and Wales.
limitations: National statistics do not establish exact local risk for a property.

sources.name: Force-comparison caution
verified_claims: Force-level differences can reflect recording practices as well as operational activity.
limitations: Raw force rankings should not be treated as direct effectiveness or safety rankings.

sources.name: Business-use boundary
verified_claims: The release contains no verified parcel candidate or business-value field.
limitations: No business row may be written from publication totals alone.

sources.name: Runtime-evidence boundary
verified_claims: The official release validates source methodology but does not execute the slot's spatial join or browser gate.
limitations: Runtime candidate values must remain zero until the canonical runner produces acceptance evidence.
